lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Daddy Pig wears glasses. He needs to wear glasses to see clearly.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸戴眼镜。他需要戴眼镜才能看清楚。

lines.en: When Daddy Pig wears his glasses, everything looks fine. But when Daddy Pig takes his glasses off, he can't see things clearly.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸戴上眼镜时，一切看起来都很清楚。可是他把眼镜摘下来时，就看不清东西了。

lines.en: Everything looks a bit soft and fuzzy. So it is very important that Daddy Pig knows where his glasses are.
lines.zh: 一切都变得有点模糊。所以猪爸爸知道自己的眼镜在哪里非常重要。

lines.en: Sometimes Daddy Pig loses his glasses. Peppa, George, have you seen Daddy Pig's glasses? He can't find them anywhere.
lines.zh: 有时候猪爸爸会弄丢眼镜。佩奇，乔治，你们看见猪爸爸的眼镜了吗？他到处都找不到。

lines.en: No, Mummy.
lines.zh: 没有，妈妈。

lines.en: Peppa and George do not know where Daddy Pig's glasses are.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治不知道猪爸爸的眼镜在哪里。

lines.en: Oh dear, Daddy Pig cannot see a thing without them, and it makes him very grumpy.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，猪爸爸没有眼镜什么都看不见，这让他脾气很不好。

lines.en: Without his glasses on, Daddy Pig cannot read his newspaper.
lines.zh: 不戴眼镜，猪爸爸就没法看报纸。

lines.en: This is ridiculous! I can't see anything! Somebody must have put my glasses somewhere.
lines.zh: 太荒唐了！我什么都看不见！一定有人把我的眼镜放到别的地方去了。

lines.en: Do you remember where you last put them, Daddy Pig?
lines.zh: 你还记得最后一次放在哪里吗，猪爸爸？

lines.en: When I don't wear them, I always put them in my pocket. But they aren't there now.
lines.zh: 我不戴的时候，总是把它们放进口袋里。可现在不在那儿。

lines.en: Daddy, can we help find your glasses?
lines.zh: 爸爸，我们可以帮你找眼镜吗？

lines.en: Good idea, Peppa. If you find them, Daddy will stop being so grumpy. I'm not grumpy!
lines.zh: 好主意，佩奇。如果你们找到了，爸爸就不会这么暴躁了。我才没有暴躁！

lines.en: Peppa and George are looking for Daddy's glasses.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在找爸爸的眼镜。

lines.en: Peppa looks under the newspaper, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
lines.zh: 佩奇在报纸下面找，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。

lines.en: George looks on top of the television, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
lines.zh: 乔治在电视机上面找，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。

lines.en: Let's look upstairs in Mummy and Daddy's bedroom.
lines.zh: 我们上楼去猪爸爸和猪妈妈的卧室找找吧。

lines.en: Peppa and George are looking in Mummy and Daddy Pig's bedroom.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在猪妈妈和猪爸爸的卧室里找。

lines.en: George, be careful not to knock anything over. It's not funny.
lines.zh: 乔治，小心别把东西碰倒了。这可不好笑。

lines.en: Peppa looks under the pillows, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
lines.zh: 佩奇在枕头底下找，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。

lines.en: George looks in Daddy's slippers, but the glasses are not there either.
lines.zh: 乔治在爸爸的拖鞋里找，眼镜也不在那里。

lines.en: Let's look in the bathroom.
lines.zh: 我们去浴室找找吧。

lines.en: Peppa and George are looking in the bathroom. The glasses are not in the bath.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在浴室里找。眼镜不在浴缸里。

lines.en: The glasses are not in the toilet.
lines.zh: 眼镜也不在马桶里。

lines.en: Peppa and George cannot find Daddy Pig's glasses anywhere.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治到处都找不到猪爸爸的眼镜。

lines.en: We've looked everywhere, but we can't find Daddy's glasses. Oh dear, now what can we do?
lines.zh: 我们到处都找过了，可就是找不到爸爸的眼镜。哦，天哪，现在我们该怎么办？

lines.en: I suppose I'll just have to learn to do without them. If I move slowly, I won't bump into things.
lines.zh: 我想我只能学着没有眼镜过日子了。如果我慢慢走，就不会撞到东西。

lines.en: There they are! Daddy's glasses!
lines.zh: 眼镜在那儿！爸爸的眼镜！

lines.en: Daddy Pig, you were sitting on them all the time!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你一直坐在它们上面！

lines.en: Oh, silly Daddy!
lines.zh: 哦，傻爸爸！

lines.en: I don't know how they got there. I wonder how.
lines.zh: 我不知道它们怎么跑到那儿去的。真奇怪。

lines.en: Well, you may have been a bit silly, Daddy Pig, but at least you're not grumpy anymore.
lines.zh: 嗯，猪爸爸，你也许是有点傻，但至少你不再暴躁了。

lines.en: I was not grumpy.
lines.zh: 我才没有暴躁。
